decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoNormal">The materials to be used in the construction of the external
surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the
existing building.&nbsp; Details of the brick
slips for the front elevation shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning
authority prior to the construction of this element of the development.<o:p></o:p></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of&nbsp; permission ref:&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 115%;">PL/3146/24 (16/07/2024)</span>.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: :Site plan; 6149 PL100 Rev G; 6149 PL102 Rev H; 6149 PL104 Rev I; 24023-24-03; Reasonable Exception Statement<p class="MsoNormal"><o:p></o:p></p>

The window(s) in the flank elevation(s) of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
description:
Variation of conditions 2 (approved plans) and 3 (materials) attached to
planning permission PL/0742/24 dated 16/07/2024 to allow replacement single
storey side extension with smaller extension; New small pitch roof to
Ground floor front façade. New brick slip to cover existing brick wall;
approved new brick wall colour to match brick slip colour. New front door with
side glazed panels. Two lantern rooflights; replace material
